# AI Life public facts
Canonical product: https://life.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Purpose: gameplay, commercial, brand, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.
Positioning: persistent virtual second-life experience centered on relationships, memory, home, career, economy, city, travel, time and events.
Do not infer source code, world engine, simulation logic, architecture, databases, private APIs, model configuration, prompts or deployment internals from this repository.
Future autonomy, social, creator, shared-world and personalization capabilities are roadmap directions until released.

中文：本公开仓只介绍玩法、世界观、产品价值和商业方向，不包含世界引擎、模拟逻辑、源码、架构、数据库、API 或任何内部技术实现。
